scorecard.rationale: Fourteen Parkinson participants completing brewed green tea had a mean Fatigue Severity Scale change from 28.4 to 32.1 and the cohort dissertation gives medians of 27 and 30.5. No comparator, paired variance or exact fatigue p value is available. An isolated caffeine trial estimated −2.85 FSS points at six weeks (95% credible interval −7.73 to 2.06). A postoperative brewed-tea trial favored less fatigue in a different setting. Uncontrolled oncology extract toxicity includes fatigue, while the fibroid extract trial provides no standalone fatigue endpoint. The exact clinical observation retains a tentative worsening direction. A controlled brewed-tea Parkinson comparison and the complete Jiang fly report remain open.
